name: Scale plate pair
description: Two pressure plates side by side, each with a weight window; the pair is balanced when both are in their window together. Put a 20 kg crate on each, or one 40 kg crate and a friend: the puzzle only asks for weight.

minWeight.description: Lightest weight that turns a plate on.

maxWeight.description: Heaviest weight that keeps it on.

inputs.name: weight-left
inputs.description: Weight resting on the left plate.

inputs.name: weight-right
inputs.description: Weight resting on the right plate.

outputs.name: balanced
outputs.description: On while both plates hold a weight inside the window.

outputs.name: left
outputs.description: On while the left plate is in its window.

outputs.name: right
outputs.description: On while the right plate is in its window.
